Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\n// The reference implementation draws all random numbers from a single\n// std::mt19937(42) fed through std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1).\n// To parallelize the consumers of that stream while keeping the exact same\n// values, the raw (untempered) MT19937 state words are produced ahead of time\n// into a buffer by a single producer; every consumer then tempers and converts\n// the words belonging to its own slice of the stream. The recurrence below is\n// the standard MT19937 one, and the conversion reproduces libstdc++'s\n// std::generate_canonical<float, 24> bit for bit (one 32-bit word per float).\nnamespace mt19937_stream {\n\nconstexpr size_t STATE_N = 624;   // MT19937 state size\nconstexpr size_t STATE_M = 397;   // MT19937 recurrence offset\n\n// Fill s[0..STATE_N-1] with the seeded initial state.\ninline void seedState(uint32_t* s, uint32_t seed) {\n    s[0] = seed;\n    for (uint32_t i = 1; i < STATE_N; ++i) {\n        s[i] = 1812433253u * (s[i - 1] ^ (s[i - 1] >> 30)) + i;\n    }\n}\n\n// buf[0..STATE_N-1] holds the STATE_N most recently produced words; this\n// appends `count` further words at buf[STATE_N...].\ninline void advance(uint32_t* buf, size_t count) {\n    for (size_t i = STATE_N; i < STATE_N + count; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t u = buf[i - STATE_N];\n        const uint32_t v = buf[i - STATE_N + 1];\n        uint32_t mixed = ((u & 0x80000000u) | (v & 0x7fffffffu)) >> 1;\n        mixed ^= (v & 1u) ? 0x9908b0dfu : 0u;\n        buf[i] = buf[i - (STATE_N - STATE_M)] ^ mixed;\n    }\n}\n\ninline uint32_t temper(uint32_t y) {\n    y ^= y >> 11;\n    y ^= (y << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u;\n    y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n    y ^= y >> 18;\n    return y;\n}\n\n// Equivalent to std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1) on a mt19937 word\ninline val_t toCanonical(uint32_t word) {\n    val_t v = static_cast<val_t>(word) * 0x1p-32f;\n    return v >= ONE ? 0x1.fffffep-1f : v;\n}\n\n}  // namespace mt19937_stream\n\n// Read-only cursor over a slice of the pre-generated MT19937 word stream\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    const uint32_t* words;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(const uint32_t* w) : words(w) {}\n    val_t rand() { return mt19937_stream::toCanonical(mt19937_stream::temper(*words++)); }\n};\n\n// Number of random values consumed per triangle pair that is not culled\nconstexpr size_t RANDS_PER_PAIR = 4 * NUM_RAYS;\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Triangles facing the same direction are culled; culled pairs consume no\n// random numbers, which is what makes the stream offset of each pair\n// predictable without running the (expensive) ray casts.\ninline bool isCulledPair(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    return triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f;\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (isCulledPair(triI, triJ)) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    if (N == 0) return;\n\n    const std::vector<Triangle>& tris = state.triangles;\n\n    // --- Number of random words consumed by each row of the Kij matrix ------\n    std::vector<uint64_t> rowStart(N + 1, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        size_t used = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i != j && !isCulledPair(tris[i], tris[j])) ++used;\n        }\n        rowStart[i + 1] = used * RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) rowStart[i + 1] += rowStart[i];\n\n    // --- Split the rows into chunks of roughly TARGET_CHUNK_WORDS randoms ---\n    // Each chunk's random words are produced by a single thread while all\n    // threads consume the previous chunk, so the (inherently sequential)\n    // generation is overlapped with the ray casting.\n    constexpr uint64_t TARGET_CHUNK_WORDS = 8ull << 20;\n    std::vector<size_t> chunkRow;\n    chunkRow.push_back(0);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N;) {\n        const uint64_t base = rowStart[i];\n        size_t end = i + 1;\n        while (end < N && rowStart[end + 1] - base <= TARGET_CHUNK_WORDS) ++end;\n        chunkRow.push_back(end);\n        i = end;\n    }\n    const size_t numChunks = chunkRow.size() - 1;\n\n    size_t maxChunkWords = 0, maxChunkRows = 0;\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < numChunks; ++c) {\n        maxChunkWords = std::max<size_t>(maxChunkWords,\n                                         rowStart[chunkRow[c + 1]] - rowStart[chunkRow[c]]);\n        maxChunkRows = std::max(maxChunkRows, chunkRow[c + 1] - chunkRow[c]);\n    }\n\n    // Double-buffered random word storage; the leading STATE_N words of each\n    // buffer carry the generator history needed to continue the recurrence.\n    constexpr size_t HIST = mt19937_stream::STATE_N;\n    std::vector<uint32_t> buffer[2];\n    buffer[0].resize(HIST + maxChunkWords);\n    buffer[1].resize(HIST + maxChunkWords);\n\n    std::vector<uint32_t> history(HIST);\n    mt19937_stream::seedState(history.data(), 42);\n\n    auto generateChunk = [&](size_t c) {\n        uint32_t* buf = buffer[c & 1].data();\n        const size_t words = static_cast<size_t>(rowStart[chunkRow[c + 1]] - rowStart[chunkRow[c]]);\n        std::copy(history.begin(), history.end(), buf);\n        mt19937_stream::advance(buf, words);\n        if (words >= HIST) {\n            std::copy(buf + words, buf + words + HIST, history.begin());\n        } else if (words > 0) {\n            std::copy(history.begin() + words, history.end(), history.begin());\n            std::copy(buf + HIST, buf + HIST + words, history.end() - words);\n        }\n    };\n\n    generateChunk(0);\n\n    // Offset of every pair within the current chunk's random word stream\n    std::vector<uint32_t> pairOffset(maxChunkRows * N);\n    std::atomic<size_t> workCursor(0);\n    constexpr size_t GRAIN = 16;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n        const int nthreads = omp_get_num_threads();\n\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < numChunks; ++c) {\n            const size_t i0 = chunkRow[c];\n            const size_t rows = chunkRow[c + 1] - i0;\n\n            // Per-pair stream offsets for this chunk (one row per thread)\n            for (size_t r = tid; r < rows; r += nthreads) {\n                const size_t i = i0 + r;\n                uint32_t off = static_cast<uint32_t>(rowStart[i] - rowStart[i0]);\n                uint32_t* po = &pairOffset[r * N];\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    po[j] = off;\n                    if (i != j && !isCulledPair(tris[i], tris[j])) off += RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            // One thread runs ahead producing the next chunk of random words\n            if (tid == 0 && c + 1 < numChunks) generateChunk(c + 1);\n\n            const uint32_t* words = buffer[c & 1].data() + HIST;\n            const size_t numPairs = rows * N;\n            for (;;) {\n                const size_t begin = workCursor.fetch_add(GRAIN, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n                if (begin >= numPairs) break;\n                const size_t end = std::min(begin + GRAIN, numPairs);\n                for (size_t p = begin; p < end; ++p) {\n                    const size_t r = p / N;\n                    const size_t j = p - r * N;\n                    const size_t i = i0 + r;\n                    if (i == j) continue;\n                    RandomGenerator rng(words + pairOffset[r * N + j]);\n                    state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                        i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            if (tid == 0) {\n                workCursor.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n                for (size_t i = i0; i < i0 + rows; ++i) {\n                    if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == N) {\n                        printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, N);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // Pre-scale the form factors by the emitter area once instead of doing it\n    // in every timestep. Culled/zero entries get weight zero, so they add\n    // exactly +0.0 and the running sum is unchanged, just as skipping them was.\n    // The weights are first-touched with the same static schedule that the\n    // timestep loop below uses, keeping each thread's rows NUMA-local.\n    std::vector<val_t> weights(N * N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const val_t* kijRow = &state.kij[i * N];\n        val_t* wRow = &weights[i * N];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            wRow[j] = kijRow[j] > ZERO ? std::min(kijRow[j] * state.areas[j], ONE) : ZERO;\n        }\n    }\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n                const val_t* wRow = &weights[i * N];\n                const int* tauRow = &state.tau[i * N];\n                val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n                // Note: j == i has weight zero and tau zero, so it reads the\n                // not-yet-written radB[t][i] (still 0) and contributes nothing.\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    const int tauij = tauRow[j];\n\n                    // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                    if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                    // Radiosity of j at the time the emission occurred\n                    const val_t radJ = state.radB[(t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij)) * N + j];\n                    if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                    // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                    sumB += wRow[j] * radJ;\n                }\n\n                // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n                state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n            }\n\n            #pragma omp single\n            {\n                if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T) {\n                    printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, T);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // The source series is shared by all correlations; gather it once.\n    std::vector<val_t> srcSeries(T);\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        srcSeries[t] = state.radB[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)];\n    }\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n    // Reused across all triangles handled by this thread\n    std::vector<val_t> series(T);\n\n    #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Gather this triangle's time series into contiguous memory\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) series[t] = state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = series[tt];\n                val_t pS = srcSeries[tt - t];\n                sum += pS * pB;\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\n// The reference implementation draws all random numbers from a single\n// std::mt19937(42) fed through std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1).\n// To parallelize the consumers of that stream while keeping the exact same\n// values, the raw (untempered) MT19937 state words are produced ahead of time\n// into a buffer by a single producer; every consumer then tempers and converts\n// the words belonging to its own slice of the stream. The recurrence below is\n// the standard MT19937 one, and the conversion reproduces libstdc++'s\n// std::generate_canonical<float, 24> bit for bit (one 32-bit word per float).\nnamespace mt19937_stream {\n\nconstexpr size_t STATE_N = 624;   // MT19937 state size\nconstexpr size_t STATE_M = 397;   // MT19937 recurrence offset\n\n// Fill s[0..STATE_N-1] with the seeded initial state.\ninline void seedState(uint32_t* s, uint32_t seed) {\n    s[0] = seed;\n    for (uint32_t i = 1; i < STATE_N; ++i) {\n        s[i] = 1812433253u * (s[i - 1] ^ (s[i - 1] >> 30)) + i;\n    }\n}\n\n// buf[0..STATE_N-1] holds the STATE_N most recently produced words; this\n// appends `count` further words at buf[STATE_N...].\ninline void advance(uint32_t* buf, size_t count) {\n    for (size_t i = STATE_N; i < STATE_N + count; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t u = buf[i - STATE_N];\n        const uint32_t v = buf[i - STATE_N + 1];\n        uint32_t mixed = ((u & 0x80000000u) | (v & 0x7fffffffu)) >> 1;\n        mixed ^= (v & 1u) ? 0x9908b0dfu : 0u;\n        buf[i] = buf[i - (STATE_N - STATE_M)] ^ mixed;\n    }\n}\n\ninline uint32_t temper(uint32_t y) {\n    y ^= y >> 11;\n    y ^= (y << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u;\n    y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n    y ^= y >> 18;\n    return y;\n}\n\n// Equivalent to std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1) on a mt19937 word\ninline val_t toCanonical(uint32_t word) {\n    val_t v = static_cast<val_t>(word) * 0x1p-32f;\n    return v >= ONE ? 0x1.fffffep-1f : v;\n}\n\n}  // namespace mt19937_stream\n\n// Read-only cursor over a slice of the pre-generated MT19937 word stream\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    const uint32_t* words;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(const uint32_t* w) : words(w) {}\n    val_t rand() { return mt19937_stream::toCanonical(mt19937_stream::temper(*words++)); }\n};\n\n// Number of random values consumed per triangle pair that is not culled\nconstexpr size_t RANDS_PER_PAIR = 4 * NUM_RAYS;\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Triangles facing the same direction are culled; culled pairs consume no\n// random numbers, which is what makes the stream offset of each pair\n// predictable without running the (expensive) ray casts.\ninline bool isCulledPair(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    return triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f;\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (isCulledPair(triI, triJ)) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    if (N == 0) return;\n\n    const std::vector<Triangle>& tris = state.triangles;\n\n    // --- Number of random words consumed by each row of the Kij matrix ------\n    std::vector<uint64_t> rowStart(N + 1, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        size_t used = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i != j && !isCulledPair(tris[i], tris[j])) ++used;\n        }\n        rowStart[i + 1] = used * RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) rowStart[i + 1] += rowStart[i];\n\n    // --- Split the rows into chunks of roughly TARGET_CHUNK_WORDS randoms ---\n    // Each chunk's random words are produced by a single thread while all\n    // threads consume the previous chunk, so the (inherently sequential)\n    // generation is overlapped with the ray casting.\n    constexpr uint64_t TARGET_CHUNK_WORDS = 8ull << 20;\n    std::vector<size_t> chunkRow;\n    chunkRow.push_back(0);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N;) {\n        const uint64_t base = rowStart[i];\n        size_t end = i + 1;\n        while (end < N && rowStart[end + 1] - base <= TARGET_CHUNK_WORDS) ++end;\n        chunkRow.push_back(end);\n        i = end;\n    }\n    const size_t numChunks = chunkRow.size() - 1;\n\n    size_t maxChunkWords = 0, maxChunkRows = 0;\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < numChunks; ++c) {\n        maxChunkWords = std::max<size_t>(maxChunkWords,\n                                         rowStart[chunkRow[c + 1]] - rowStart[chunkRow[c]]);\n        maxChunkRows = std::max(maxChunkRows, chunkRow[c + 1] - chunkRow[c]);\n    }\n\n    // Double-buffered random word storage; the leading STATE_N words of each\n    // buffer carry the generator history needed to continue the recurrence.\n    constexpr size_t HIST = mt19937_stream::STATE_N;\n    std::vector<uint32_t> buffer[2];\n    buffer[0].resize(HIST + maxChunkWords);\n    buffer[1].resize(HIST + maxChunkWords);\n\n    std::vector<uint32_t> history(HIST);\n    mt19937_stream::seedState(history.data(), 42);\n\n    auto generateChunk = [&](size_t c) {\n        uint32_t* buf = buffer[c & 1].data();\n        const size_t words = static_cast<size_t>(rowStart[chunkRow[c + 1]] - rowStart[chunkRow[c]]);\n        std::copy(history.begin(), history.end(), buf);\n        mt19937_stream::advance(buf, words);\n        if (words >= HIST) {\n            std::copy(buf + words, buf + words + HIST, history.begin());\n        } else if (words > 0) {\n            std::copy(history.begin() + words, history.end(), history.begin());\n            std::copy(buf + HIST, buf + HIST + words, history.end() - words);\n        }\n    };\n\n    generateChunk(0);\n\n    // Offset of every pair within the current chunk's random word stream\n    std::vector<uint32_t> pairOffset(maxChunkRows * N);\n    std::atomic<size_t> workCursor(0);\n    constexpr size_t GRAIN = 16;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n        const int nthreads = omp_get_num_threads();\n\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < numChunks; ++c) {\n            const size_t i0 = chunkRow[c];\n            const size_t rows = chunkRow[c + 1] - i0;\n\n            // Per-pair stream offsets for this chunk (one row per thread)\n            for (size_t r = tid; r < rows; r += nthreads) {\n                const size_t i = i0 + r;\n                uint32_t off = static_cast<uint32_t>(rowStart[i] - rowStart[i0]);\n                uint32_t* po = &pairOffset[r * N];\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    po[j] = off;\n                    if (i != j && !isCulledPair(tris[i], tris[j])) off += RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            // One thread runs ahead producing the next chunk of random words\n            if (tid == 0 && c + 1 < numChunks) generateChunk(c + 1);\n\n            const uint32_t* words = buffer[c & 1].data() + HIST;\n            const size_t numPairs = rows * N;\n            for (;;) {\n                const size_t begin = workCursor.fetch_add(GRAIN, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n                if (begin >= numPairs) break;\n                const size_t end = std::min(begin + GRAIN, numPairs);\n                for (size_t p = begin; p < end; ++p) {\n                    const size_t r = p / N;\n                    const size_t j = p - r * N;\n                    const size_t i = i0 + r;\n                    if (i == j) continue;\n                    RandomGenerator rng(words + pairOffset[r * N + j]);\n                    state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                        i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            if (tid == 0) {\n                workCursor.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n                for (size_t i = i0; i < i0 + rows; ++i) {\n                    if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == N) {\n                        printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, N);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // Pre-scale the form factors by the emitter area once instead of doing it\n    // in every timestep. Culled/zero entries get weight zero, so they add\n    // exactly +0.0 and the running sum is unchanged, just as skipping them was.\n    // The weights are first-touched with the same static schedule that the\n    // timestep loop below uses, keeping each thread's rows NUMA-local.\n    std::vector<val_t> weights(N * N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const val_t* kijRow = &state.kij[i * N];\n        val_t* wRow = &weights[i * N];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            wRow[j] = kijRow[j] > ZERO ? std::min(kijRow[j] * state.areas[j], ONE) : ZERO;\n        }\n    }\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n                const val_t* wRow = &weights[i * N];\n                const int* tauRow = &state.tau[i * N];\n                val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n                // Note: j == i has weight zero and tau zero, so it reads the\n                // not-yet-written radB[t][i] (still 0) and contributes nothing.\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    const int tauij = tauRow[j];\n\n                    // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                    if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                    // Radiosity of j at the time the emission occurred\n                    const val_t radJ = state.radB[(t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij)) * N + j];\n                    if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                    // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                    sumB += wRow[j] * radJ;\n                }\n\n                // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n                state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n            }\n\n            #pragma omp single\n            {\n                if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T) {\n                    printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, T);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // The source series is shared by all correlations; gather it once.\n    std::vector<val_t> srcSeries(T);\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        srcSeries[t] = state.radB[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)];\n    }\n\n    // Scratch space (one row per thread) allocated up front: allocating inside\n    // the parallel region costs far more than the correlations themselves.\n    const int maxThreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<val_t> scratch(static_cast<size_t>(maxThreads) * T);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n    // Reused across all triangles handled by this thread\n    val_t* series = &scratch[static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num()) * T];\n\n    #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Gather this triangle's time series into contiguous memory\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) series[t] = state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = series[tt];\n                val_t pS = srcSeries[tt - t];\n                sum += pS * pB;\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\npublic:\n    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n\n        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n    template<typename Func>\n    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Otherwise, descend to children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\n// The reference implementation draws all random numbers from a single\n// std::mt19937(42) fed through std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1).\n// To parallelize the consumers of that stream while keeping the exact same\n// values, the raw (untempered) MT19937 state words are produced ahead of time\n// into a buffer by a single producer; every consumer then tempers and converts\n// the words belonging to its own slice of the stream. The recurrence below is\n// the standard MT19937 one, and the conversion reproduces libstdc++'s\n// std::generate_canonical<float, 24> bit for bit (one 32-bit word per float).\nnamespace mt19937_stream {\n\nconstexpr size_t STATE_N = 624;   // MT19937 state size\nconstexpr size_t STATE_M = 397;   // MT19937 recurrence offset\n\n// Fill s[0..STATE_N-1] with the seeded initial state.\ninline void seedState(uint32_t* s, uint32_t seed) {\n    s[0] = seed;\n    for (uint32_t i = 1; i < STATE_N; ++i) {\n        s[i] = 1812433253u * (s[i - 1] ^ (s[i - 1] >> 30)) + i;\n    }\n}\n\n// buf[0..STATE_N-1] holds the STATE_N most recently produced words; this\n// appends `count` further words at buf[STATE_N...].\ninline void advance(uint32_t* buf, size_t count) {\n    for (size_t i = STATE_N; i < STATE_N + count; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t u = buf[i - STATE_N];\n        const uint32_t v = buf[i - STATE_N + 1];\n        uint32_t mixed = ((u & 0x80000000u) | (v & 0x7fffffffu)) >> 1;\n        mixed ^= (v & 1u) ? 0x9908b0dfu : 0u;\n        buf[i] = buf[i - (STATE_N - STATE_M)] ^ mixed;\n    }\n}\n\ninline uint32_t temper(uint32_t y) {\n    y ^= y >> 11;\n    y ^= (y << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u;\n    y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n    y ^= y >> 18;\n    return y;\n}\n\n// Equivalent to std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1) on a mt19937 word\ninline val_t toCanonical(uint32_t word) {\n    val_t v = static_cast<val_t>(word) * 0x1p-32f;\n    return v >= ONE ? 0x1.fffffep-1f : v;\n}\n\n}  // namespace mt19937_stream\n\n// Read-only cursor over a slice of the pre-generated MT19937 word stream\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    const uint32_t* words;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(const uint32_t* w) : words(w) {}\n    val_t rand() { return mt19937_stream::toCanonical(mt19937_stream::temper(*words++)); }\n};\n\n// Number of random values consumed per triangle pair that is not culled\nconstexpr size_t RANDS_PER_PAIR = 4 * NUM_RAYS;\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Triangles facing the same direction are culled; culled pairs consume no\n// random numbers, which is what makes the stream offset of each pair\n// predictable without running the (expensive) ray casts.\ninline bool isCulledPair(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    return triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f;\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (isCulledPair(triI, triJ)) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    if (N == 0) return;\n\n    const std::vector<Triangle>& tris = state.triangles;\n\n    // --- Number of random words consumed by each row of the Kij matrix ------\n    std::vector<uint64_t> rowStart(N + 1, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        size_t used = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i != j && !isCulledPair(tris[i], tris[j])) ++used;\n        }\n        rowStart[i + 1] = used * RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) rowStart[i + 1] += rowStart[i];\n\n    // --- Split the rows into chunks of roughly TARGET_CHUNK_WORDS randoms ---\n    // Each chunk's random words are produced by a single thread while all\n    // threads consume the previous chunk, so the (inherently sequential)\n    // generation is overlapped with the ray casting.\n    constexpr uint64_t TARGET_CHUNK_WORDS = 8ull << 20;\n    std::vector<size_t> chunkRow;\n    chunkRow.push_back(0);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N;) {\n        const uint64_t base = rowStart[i];\n        size_t end = i + 1;\n        while (end < N && rowStart[end + 1] - base <= TARGET_CHUNK_WORDS) ++end;\n        chunkRow.push_back(end);\n        i = end;\n    }\n    const size_t numChunks = chunkRow.size() - 1;\n\n    size_t maxChunkWords = 0, maxChunkRows = 0;\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < numChunks; ++c) {\n        maxChunkWords = std::max<size_t>(maxChunkWords,\n                                         rowStart[chunkRow[c + 1]] - rowStart[chunkRow[c]]);\n        maxChunkRows = std::max(maxChunkRows, chunkRow[c + 1] - chunkRow[c]);\n    }\n\n    // Double-buffered random word storage; the leading STATE_N words of each\n    // buffer carry the generator history needed to continue the recurrence.\n    constexpr size_t HIST = mt19937_stream::STATE_N;\n    std::vector<uint32_t> buffer[2];\n    buffer[0].resize(HIST + maxChunkWords);\n    buffer[1].resize(HIST + maxChunkWords);\n\n    std::vector<uint32_t> history(HIST);\n    mt19937_stream::seedState(history.data(), 42);\n\n    auto generateChunk = [&](size_t c) {\n        uint32_t* buf = buffer[c & 1].data();\n        const size_t words = static_cast<size_t>(rowStart[chunkRow[c + 1]] - rowStart[chunkRow[c]]);\n        std::copy(history.begin(), history.end(), buf);\n        mt19937_stream::advance(buf, words);\n        if (words >= HIST) {\n            std::copy(buf + words, buf + words + HIST, history.begin());\n        } else if (words > 0) {\n            std::copy(history.begin() + words, history.end(), history.begin());\n            std::copy(buf + HIST, buf + HIST + words, history.end() - words);\n        }\n    };\n\n    generateChunk(0);\n\n    // Offset of every pair within the current chunk's random word stream\n    std::vector<uint32_t> pairOffset(maxChunkRows * N);\n    std::atomic<size_t> workCursor(0);\n    constexpr size_t GRAIN = 16;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n        const int nthreads = omp_get_num_threads();\n\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < numChunks; ++c) {\n            const size_t i0 = chunkRow[c];\n            const size_t rows = chunkRow[c + 1] - i0;\n\n            // Per-pair stream offsets for this chunk (one row per thread)\n            for (size_t r = tid; r < rows; r += nthreads) {\n                const size_t i = i0 + r;\n                uint32_t off = static_cast<uint32_t>(rowStart[i] - rowStart[i0]);\n                uint32_t* po = &pairOffset[r * N];\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    po[j] = off;\n                    if (i != j && !isCulledPair(tris[i], tris[j])) off += RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            // One thread runs ahead producing the next chunk of random words\n            if (tid == 0 && c + 1 < numChunks) generateChunk(c + 1);\n\n            const uint32_t* words = buffer[c & 1].data() + HIST;\n            const size_t numPairs = rows * N;\n            for (;;) {\n                const size_t begin = workCursor.fetch_add(GRAIN, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n                if (begin >= numPairs) break;\n                const size_t end = std::min(begin + GRAIN, numPairs);\n                for (size_t p = begin; p < end; ++p) {\n                    const size_t r = p / N;\n                    const size_t j = p - r * N;\n                    const size_t i = i0 + r;\n                    if (i == j) continue;\n                    RandomGenerator rng(words + pairOffset[r * N + j]);\n                    state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                        i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            if (tid == 0) {\n                workCursor.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n                for (size_t i = i0; i < i0 + rows; ++i) {\n                    if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == N) {\n                        printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, N);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // Timesteps are sequentially dependent (a step reads radiosities emitted at\n    // earlier times), so only the triangle loop is distributed. Every triangle i\n    // writes exactly one element, radB[t][i], and no other triangle reads that\n    // element at this timestep because tau[i][j] >= 1 for j != i - so the rows\n    // are independent. The accumulation itself is kept element for element as in\n    // the serial version: reordering or pre-scaling it would change the floating\n    // point rounding of the result.\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n                const val_t* kijRow = &state.kij[i * N];\n                const int* tauRow = &state.tau[i * N];\n                val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    if (i == j) continue;\n\n                    int tauij = tauRow[j];\n\n                    // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                    if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                    val_t kij = kijRow[j];\n                    if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                    // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n                    size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n                    val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n                    if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                    // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                    sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n                }\n\n                // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n                state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n            }\n\n            #pragma omp single\n            {\n                if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T) {\n                    printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, T);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // The source series is shared by all correlations; gather it once.\n    std::vector<val_t> srcSeries(T);\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        srcSeries[t] = state.radB[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)];\n    }\n\n    // Scratch space (one row per thread) allocated up front: allocating inside\n    // the parallel region costs far more than the correlations themselves.\n    const int maxThreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<val_t> scratch(static_cast<size_t>(maxThreads) * T);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n    // Reused across all triangles handled by this thread\n    val_t* series = &scratch[static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num()) * T];\n\n    #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Gather this triangle's time series into contiguous memory\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) series[t] = state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for
